findings: `detailUrl` TDZ crash in `new_order` handler — `row.dataset.detailUrl = detailUrl` (and five sibling assignments) appear ~19 lines before the corresponding `const` declarations. Every `new_order` SSE event throws `ReferenceError: Cannot access 'detailUrl' before initialization`, falls to the `catch` block, and reloads the page after 2 s. Move all six `const` URL declarations to immediately before the `row.dataset.*` block, or hoist them above the `row = document.createElement('tr')` line.

SSE-inserted rows have no `data-detail-url` until reload — as a consequence of the TDZ crash, any row inserted live lacks `data-detail-url`, so the delegated click handler's `e.target.closest('tr[data-detail-url]')` check silently drops clicks on it. Resolves automatically once the `const` declarations are moved.
